import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    allowed = ["Electronics", "Accessories", "Furniture", "Office Supplies"]
    df["Category"] = df["Category"].str.strip()
    df = df[df["Category"].isin(allowed)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    category_sums = df.groupby("Category")["Revenue"].sum().to_dict()
    total = df["Revenue"].sum()
    category_sums["all"] = total
    return category_sums
